name: Eternal Precision Mechanics Co., Ltd.
summary: Eternal Precision Mechanics Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells vacuum laminating machine equipment in Taiwan and internationally. Its products are used in AI, face recognition, 5G network, communication system, in-vehicle system, and PC/NB applications. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. Eternal Precision Mechanics Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Changxing Materials Industry Co., Ltd.
